title: Fuinha - Network Monitor
insight_upload_saturation: ALERT: High upload detected! This can make your browsing slow.
insight_high_download: INFO: You are downloading data at high speed. Enjoy!
insight_no_admin: WARNING: Run as Admin to identify which apps are using the network.
insight_tip_1: Tip: Saturated Upload usually freezes online games and video calls.
insight_tip_2: Tip: Close Torrent apps if you're not using them to free up your connection.
insight_tip_3: Tip: Fuinha helps you find out who is 'eating' your internet.
